atq.text: Loran traveled from Penregon to Terisia City, met the scholars at the Ivory Tower, and during the Fall of Terisia City escaped with the Sylex.
She was caught in an avalanche triggered by Ashnod, who captured and interrogated her, and Loran escaped in 57 AR without the Sylex.
Feldon rescued her after several years and they married and lived near Ronom Glacier, where they were present for the Sylex Blast and realized the war was over.
Loran died ten years after the Sylex Blast, and Feldon grieved and tried to replace her.
